blocks.text: Chef Jose Gerard Patrick Apurado, known as Chef Gerard, is now Head Pastry Chef at Naya Mayfair in London and a finalist in the Hospitality category of the 2026 Forty Under 40 UK Awards. The recognition marks a new chapter in a career that began in Cebu, where he worked his way up from the most junior kitchen position at Plantation Bay Resort and Spa. More than a story of moving from one kitchen to another, Chef Gerard’s journey shows how Cebu became a formative part of the creativity, discipline and perspective he now brings to the international pastry scene.
